title: About | Family-Owned Detroit Dispensary
description: Learn about House of Zen, a family-owned Detroit cannabis dispensary built on education, quality, community and personalized customer care.

blocks.html: The House of Zen offers a curated cannabis experience focused on balance, education, and quality. Explore premium products selected with care to support mindful choices and everyday wellness naturally.

sections.heading: Built on Family. Guided by Purpose.

blocks.text: Built on Family. Guided by Purpose.

blocks.html: House of Zen began as a family vision—to create a dispensary experience that feels calm, welcoming, and intentional.
In an industry that can often feel overwhelming, we set out to create something different:
A space where education comes first, quality is non-negotiable, and every customer is treated like family.
Today, House of Zen continues to grow with the same foundation it started with—trust, care, and community.Our team is here to guide you through:
Our team is made up of knowledgeable, approachable professionals who are here to help you navigate your experience confidently.
Shop thoughtfully curated cannabis products designed to support your lifestyle.
Everything you need to know, explained clearly and simply.

items.a_html: We offer flower, pre-rolls, edibles, concentrates, topicals, CBD products, and glass accessories.
Absolutely. We specialize in guiding first-time customers with clear education and recommendations.

items.q: All products are licensed and tested?
items.a_html: Yes. All products are fully licensed, lab-tested, and compliant with state regulations.

items.q: How do I choose the right product?
items.a_html: Our team will help you based on your comfort level, preferences, and desired experience.
